name: El Gran Hotel: Gestión Hotelera Integral
description: Three-round turnaround simulation where students act as the executive committee of Hotel Gran Palacio Regio, a struggling 5-star business hotel in Monterrey, Mexico. Participants diagnose RevPAR gaps, optimize F&B operations, allocate capital investments, and navigate competitive threats while aiming to restore GOP margins from 17% to 25%.
